data.change_summary: Compared the four pending amendments against current HEAD and found they are already present: snapshot TDS/conductivity is derived from the fresh carbonate solve, the 7-ion TDS scope metadata is centralized in `tank_core` and consumed by API/TUI, the TUI snapshot parser strips legacy chemistry aliases plus API metadata and has enriched snapshot/load regression coverage, and dissolved-oxygen now has a default-geometry SA/V guard test. No net code changes were needed in this round.
outstanding_risks: The pending-amendment list was stale relative to current HEAD, so this round produced validation rather than a new patch/commit.
`cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_api -p tank_tui -- -D warnings` is still blocked by an unrelated pre-existing warning in `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:755` (`clippy::redundant_field_names`).
Validation was targeted to the amended core/API/TUI paths; I did not rerun the full workspace test matrix.

steps.description: Compared the pending amendment list against the current `tank_core`, `tank_api`, and `tank_tui` sources to determine whether any runtime gaps still remained.
Confirmed that current HEAD already includes the fresh-carbonate snapshot TDS/conductivity path plus shared 7-ion scope metadata exported from `tank_core` and consumed by API/TUI.

Confirmed that the TUI client now strips legacy chemistry aliases and API metadata before deserializing, with regression coverage for enriched `/snapshot` and `/load` payloads, and that dissolved-oxygen includes the default SA/V reference test.
Skipped additional file edits because the repository already satisfied the pending amendment list.
Ran targeted formatting and verification commands to validate the existing implementation and record the remaining unrelated clippy blocker.

validation_evidence: `rustfmt --edition 2021 crates/tank_core/src/systems/chemistry.rs crates/tank_core/src/systems/dissolved_oxygen.rs crates/tank_core/src/types/water.rs crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs crates/tank_core/src/types/mod.rs crates/tank_api/src/handlers/snapshot.rs crates/tank_tui/src/api_client.rs crates/tank_tui/src/screens/mod.rs` completed successfully.

`cargo test -p tank_core --lib` passed (47 tests), including `systems::dissolved_oxygen::tests::reference_sa_v_matches_default_tank_geometry` and `types::snapshot::tests::snapshot_tds_and_conductivity_use_fresh_carbonate_projection`.
`cargo test -p tank_tui --lib` passed (9 tests), including enriched snapshot and `/load` compatibility coverage.
`cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_api -p tank_tui -- -D warnings` failed outside this bead because `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:755` already triggers `clippy::redundant_field_names`.
